Silicobra

Ground

Galar · Generation 8

Silicobra is a Ground-type Sand Snake Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 2.2 m tall and weighs 7.6 kg. It evolves into Sandaconda. Its highest base stat is Defense (75), with a base stat total of 315.
